up: List distinct target descriptions for Caenorhabditis elegans assays with activities. The output should contain only the distinct target description values.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name AS target_description FROM assays ass JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id WHERE ass.assay_organism = 'Caenorhabditis elegans'
